title: Automated config reconciliation with hysteresis controls and cost-aware rollback
creator: Priya Singh
description: We need an automated system that safely applies configuration changes across serving pools and can reconcile drift while minimizing cost regression. The feature will add hysteresis and acceptance windows to avoid flapping, run simulated cost/delta checks before applying batching/caching recommendations, and provide an automatic safe-rollback path based on solid state reconciliation rather than ad-hoc triggers. This ticket contains the implementation plan for the reconciler, guardrails, and the rollback orchestration that coordinates across Dedicated pools and hosted routing. Goal: prevent costly regressions from config churn while enabling automated cost optimizations (batching/caching) to be applied safely.
acceptance_criteria: Automated reconciler compares desired config to observed state for all serving pools and converges within SLA (config-apply window configurable, default 5m)
Hysteresis: repeated changes within a short window are suppressed; default window 15m and configurable per-tenant/pool

Pre-apply simulation: for batching/caching proposals, a simulation step estimates token-cost delta and latency percentiles; changes with >10% cost increase or >95th percentile latency degradation fail pre-apply unless forced
Safe-apply algorithm performs staged application (canary -> gradual ramp -> full) and supports transactional rollback at each stage
Rollback is automatic when production metrics breach thresholds from config baseline (cost, P95 latency, error-rate) and must include state reconciliation to original config or a known-good fallback
All reconciler actions are auditable (who/what/when) and surfaced in Console with links to related PRs and rollback events
Integration tests simulate network and GPU failures and show reconciler does not leave pools in inconsistent states
Canary and rollout policies are configurable per project with sensible defaults and documented in Console and API
technical_approach: Controller: implement a proactive reconciler service that polls desired state from config-store and observed state from runtime telemetry; uses idempotent compare-and-swap to make changes
Hysteresis layer: track change history per-key and suppress repeated applies using sliding windows and exponential backoff; exposes per-tenant overrides
Simulation step: run a lightweight offline estimator that uses recent traffic histograms and KV cache hit-rates to estimate cost/latency deltas for batching and caching changes
Staged apply flow: 1) shadow-apply to a subset of replicas (no routing) to validate behavior; 2) canary routing to X% traffic for Y minutes; 3) phased ramp to 100% with rollback checkpoints
Rollback coordinator: upon threshold breach, coordinator triggers automated rollback jobs that execute reverse apply steps and validate via reconciliation loop
Atomic batch applies: group dependent config keys into a single transaction (logical) so partial failures trigger automatic revert of applied keys
State reconciliation: record pre-change snapshot and post-change state; reconciler verifies actual config matches target and retries with backoff if not
Store: extend config-store schema to keep apply-metadata (initiator, commit SHA, simulation results, signatures) for audit and blame
Metrics: emit granular metrics (apply_latency, reconcile_attempts, rollback_count, simulation_cost_delta) and structured logs for tracing
rollout_plan: Phase A (staging): deploy reconciler in staging with only shadow-apply enabled; monitor for 2 weeks and run chaos tests
Phase B (limited): enable canary applies for internal customers; default canary 5% for 30m; validate alerts and rollback behavior
Phase C (wide): enable for paid tenants with opt-out and per-tenant hysteresis settings; run a retrospective after first month
Backout plan: manual kill-switch in Console to disable automated applies globally; per-project toggle to pause reconciler
Documentation and SDK updates: document new API flags and Console toggles; add sample scripts for contraception of safe-apply policies
monitoring_and_alerting: Create dashboard: reconciler health, pending-deltas, average-simulation-delta, active-rollbacks
Alert: Reconciler failing >5 consecutive attempts for any pool -> P1 on-call
Alert: Auto-rollback triggered -> notify owners and open incident if rollback fails to converge in 10 minutes
SLOs: reconciler should reconcile 95% of non-conflicting config changes within 10 minutes
Audit logs: every apply and rollback must be persisted and visible in Console with links to telemetry windows
test_plan: Unit tests for hysteresis logic and suppression windows
Integration tests simulating overlapping config changes, ensuring last-writer-wins semantics and no partial applies
Load tests: apply large batches of config changes (1000 keys) and verify time-to-converge and rollback behavior
Chaos tests: simulate replica flaps, leader election, and network partitions while reconciler runs
E2E canary: create synthetic workload to validate simulation cost estimator against observed cost delta within 15% error
risks: False positives in simulation could block benign optimizations; mitigation: allow forced apply with human confirmation and improve estimator accuracy
Reconciler bugs could cause larger blast radius; mitigation: phased rollout, per-project opt-outs, and global kill-switch
Complexity around cross-pool transactions; mitigation: conservative defaults and slow ramping for multi-pool changes
Operator overload with noisy rollbacks; mitigation: hysteresis + adaptive suppression + grouped notifications
updates: 2025-02-18: Ticket created by Priya Singh. Added high-level goals and acceptance criteria.
2025-02-25: Design review with runtime and SRE teams. Agreed on staged apply flow and simulation gate. Theo assigned for implementation.
2025-03-01: Prototype reconciler running in staging with shadow-apply. Initial simulation estimator shows median error 20% on small workloads; improving estimator models next.
2025-03-05: Added global kill-switch and per-project opt-out controls to rollout plan after SRE feedback. Adjusted default hysteresis window to 15m.
